    }
  })}
EOT

  file_permission = "0600"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 504
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 4  # OCR is CPU intensive
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 8192  # OCR needs memory
}

variable "swap" {
  type    = number
  default = 2048
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 64  # Documents can grow large
}

# Cloud backup schedule (default: Wed and Sun at 3:30 AM, after photos backup)
variable "cloud_backup_schedule" {
  type    = string
  default = "30 3 * * 0,3"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Documents Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "documents" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "documents"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.monitoring.documents}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Ensure .env is generated before file sync
  depends_on = [local_sensitive_file.documents_env]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = local.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Documents"
  service_description = "Document management with Paperless-ngx (OCR) and Stirling-PDF (utilities)"

  service_urls = {
    paperless_internal    = "https://docs.${var.domain_internal}"
    paperless_public      = "https://docs.${var.domain_public}"
    stirling_pdf_internal = "https://pdf.${var.domain_internal}"
    stirling_pdf_public   = "https://pdf.${var.domain_public}"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Paperless-ngx", port = 8000, info = "Document management with OCR" },
    { name = "Stirling-PDF", port = 8080, info = "PDF manipulation tools" },
    { name = "PostgreSQL", port = 5432, info = "Paperless database (internal)" },
    { name = "Redis", port = 6379, info = "Paperless cache (internal)" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f paperless
cd /config && docker compose logs -f stirling-pdf
```

**Restart services:**
```
cd /config && docker compose restart paperless
cd /config && docker compose restart stirling-pdf
```

**Import documents:**
Place files in `/config/consume/` - they'll be automatically imported.

**Export all documents:**
```
cd /config && docker compose exec paperless document_exporter ../export/
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=documents` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["documents", "paperless", "pdf", "ocr"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "documents_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.documents.container_id
  container_ip   = module.documents.ip_address
  container_name = "documents"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = local.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "daily"
    retention = "7"
    namespace = "lxc-504"

    pre_backup_commands = [{
      name    = "PostgreSQL dump (Paperless)"
      command = "docker exec paperless-db pg_dump -U paperless -d paperless --clean --if-exists | gzip > /config/paperless-db-backup.sql.gz"
      timeout = 300
    }]

    include_paths = ["/config", "/var/lib/docker/volumes"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,documents,paperless"
  }

  # Container monitoring agents
  pulse_agent = {
    enabled     = true
    pulse_token = local.agent_tokens["documents"].pulse_token
  }

  arcane_agent = {
    enabled         = true
    bootstrap_token = local.agent_tokens["documents"].arcane_bootstrap_token
  }

  alloy_agent = {
    enabled  = true
    username = local.op.alloy_telemetry_username
    password = local.op.alloy_telemetry_password
  }

  depends_on = [module.documents]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Cloud Backup - rclone to Backblaze B2
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Generate rclone config from 1Password secrets
resource "local_sensitive_file" "rclone_conf" {
  filename = "${path.module}/.tmp/rclone.conf"
  content  = <<-CONF
[b2]
type = b2
account = ${local.op.b2_account_id}
key = ${local.op.b2_application_key}
hard_delete = true

[b2-crypt]
type = crypt
remote = b2:rambtech-homelab/documents
password = ${local.op.rclone_crypt_password}
password2 = ${local.op.rclone_crypt_password2}
CONF
}

# Install rclone via Ansible
resource "ansible_navigator_run" "install_rclone" {
  depends_on = [module.documents]

  triggers = {
    container_id = var.container_id
  }

  execution_environment = {
    enabled = false
  }

  ansible_options = {
    private_keys = [{
      name = "homelab"
      data = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    }]
  }

  playbook = <<-EOT
    - name: Install rclone for cloud backup
      hosts: lxc
      gather_facts: no

      tasks:
        - name: Check if rclone is installed
          ansible.builtin.command:
            cmd: which rclone
          register: rclone_check
          changed_when: false
          failed_when: false

        - name: Install rclone
          ansible.builtin.shell:
            cmd: curl -fsSL https://rclone.org/install.sh | bash
          when: rclone_check.rc != 0

        - name: Create rclone config directory
          ansible.builtin.file:
            path: /root/.config/rclone
            state: directory
            mode: '0700'

        - name: Ensure cron is installed
          ansible.builtin.apt:
            name: cron
            state: present
            update_cache: yes
            cache_valid_time: 3600
  EOT

  inventory = yamlencode({
    lxc = {
      hosts = {
        "documents" = {
          ansible_host = module.documents.ip_address
          ansible_user = "root"
        }
      }
    }
  })
}

# Deploy rclone config
resource "filesync_file" "rclone_conf" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.rclone_conf.filename
  destination = "/root/.config/rclone/rclone.conf"
  host        = module.documents.ip_address

  mode         = "0600"
  ssh_user     = "root"
  ssh_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [ansible_navigator_run.install_rclone]
}

# Deploy cloud-sync script
resource "filesync_file" "cloud_sync_script" {
  source      = "${path.module}/deploy/cloud-sync.sh"
  destination = "/usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh"
  host        = module.documents.ip_address

  mode         = "0755"
  ssh_user     = "root"
  ssh_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [ansible_navigator_run.install_rclone]
}

# Configure cron job for cloud backup
resource "ansible_navigator_run" "configure_cron" {
  depends_on = [
    filesync_file.cloud_sync_script,
    filesync_file.rclone_conf
  ]

  triggers = {
    container_id   = var.container_id
    cloud_schedule = var.cloud_backup_schedule
  }

  execution_environment = {
    enabled = false
  }

  ansible_options = {
    private_keys = [{
      name = "homelab"
      data = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    }]
  }

  playbook = <<-EOT
    - name: Configure cloud backup cron job
      hosts: lxc
      gather_facts: no
      vars:
        cloud_schedule: "${var.cloud_backup_schedule}"

      tasks:
        - name: Add cloud backup cron job (B2 sync)
          ansible.builtin.cron:
            name: "Cloud backup documents to B2"
            minute: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[0] }}"
            hour: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[1] }}"
            day: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[2] }}"
            month: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[3] }}"
            weekday: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[4] }}"
            job: "/usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh documents >> /var/log/cloud-sync-documents.log 2>&1"
            user: root

        - name: Ensure cron service is enabled and running
          ansible.builtin.systemd:
            name: cron
            enabled: yes
            state: started

        - name: Display cron configuration
          ansible.builtin.debug:
            msg: "Cloud backup configured: {{ cloud_schedule }}"
  EOT

  inventory = yamlencode({
    lxc = {
      hosts = {
        "documents" = {
          ansible_host = module.documents.ip_address
          ansible_user = "root"
        }
      }
    }
  })
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Routes - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Paperless-ngx route (internal only)
module "paperless_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "docs"
  backend_url = "http://${module.documents.ip_address}:8000"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "docs.${var.domain_internal}"
  public_domain   = "docs.${var.domain_public}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]
  public_middlewares   = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.documents]
}

# Stirling-PDF route (internal only)
module "stirling_pdf_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "pdf"
  backend_url = "http://${module.documents.ip_address}:8080"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "pdf.${var.domain_internal}"
  public_domain   = "pdf.${var.domain_public}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares - authentik provides SSO authentication
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers", "authentik"]
  public_middlewares   = ["cloudflare-https", "security-headers", "authentik"]
  public_entrypoint    = ["web"]

  depends_on = [module.documents]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.documents.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.documents.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.documents.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    direct_paperless      = "http://${module.documents.ip_address}:8000"
    paperless_internal    = module.paperless_route.internal_url
    paperless_public      = module.paperless_route.public_url

    direct_stirling_pdf   = "http://${module.documents.ip_address}:8080"
    stirling_pdf_internal = module.stirling_pdf_route.internal_url
    stirling_pdf_public   = module.stirling_pdf_route.public_url
  }
}

output "traefik_config_paths" {
  description = "Paths to Traefik configs on Traefik LXC"
  value = {
    paperless    = module.paperless_route.remote_config_path
    stirling_pdf = module.stirling_pdf_route.remote_config_path
  }
}

# Homelab Backup Strategy

## Overview

Two-tier backup system with daily backups for user data services and weekly backups for infrastructure. All backups are synced to Backblaze B2 (encrypted) for off-site redundancy.

## Backup Tiers

### Daily Backups (2:00 AM)

User data that changes frequently - kept for 7 days.

| ID | Service | Pre-Backup Hook |
|----|---------|-----------------|
| 304 | Immich | PostgreSQL dump |
| 501 | OpenWebUI | SQLite copy |
| 502 | n8n | SQLite copy |

### Weekly Backups (Sunday 3:00 AM)

Infrastructure services that rarely change - kept for 4 weeks.

| ID | Service | Pre-Backup Hook |
|----|---------|-----------------|
| 101 | Network Services (AdGuard) | None |
| 200 | Traefik | None |
| 201 | Dashboards | None |
| 202 | Authelia | None |
| 401 | Jellyfin | Jellystat PostgreSQL dump |
| 402 | Media Management | None |
| 500 | Monitoring | None |

### Excluded Containers

- **303 (immich-importer)** - Stateless, runs cron jobs only
- **600 (desktop-tmp)** - Temporary GUI container

## Cloud Backup (Backblaze B2)

All local backups are synced to Backblaze B2 with rclone crypt encryption.

| Sync | Schedule | Source | Destination |
|------|----------|--------|-------------|
| Photos | Daily 3:00 AM | LXC 303 `/photos` | `b2-crypt:` |
| Vzdump | Daily 4:00 AM | `/tank/backups/vzdump` | `b2-crypt:vzdump` |
| DB Dumps | Daily 4:00 AM | `/tank/backups/database-dumps` | `b2-crypt:database-dumps` |

### Daily Timeline

```text
2:00 AM - Daily vzdump backups (immich, openwebui, n8n)
3:00 AM - Photos cloud sync to B2
4:00 AM - Vzdump + DB dumps cloud sync to B2
```

## Storage Layout

```text
/tank/backups/
├── vzdump/dump/           # Proxmox vzdump backups
│   ├── vzdump-lxc-100-*.tar.zst
│   ├── vzdump-lxc-101-*.tar.zst
│   └── ...
└── database-dumps/        # Pre-backup database dumps
    ├── immich-postgres-*.sql.gz
    ├── jellystat-postgres-*.sql.gz
    ├── openwebui-*.db
    └── n8n-*.db
```

## Taskfile Commands

### Local Backups

```bash
# Sync backup config to Proxmox
task backup:sync

# View status
task backup:status

# Manual backups
task backup:now APP=openwebui    # Single container
task backup:all                   # All containers

# List backups for an app
task backup:list APP=immich

# Restore container
task backup:restore BACKUP=vzdump-lxc-304-2025_12_07-02_00_00.tar.zst TARGET_ID=305

# Immich database operations
task backup:immich:db              # Manual dump
task backup:immich:db:restore DUMP=immich-postgres-20251207_020000.sql.gz
```

### Cloud Backups

```bash
# Trigger cloud sync
task cloud:sync              # Both vzdump + photos
task cloud:sync:vzdump       # Vzdump only
task cloud:sync:photos       # Photos only

# Check status
task cloud:status            # B2 bucket sizes
task cloud:status:photos     # Photos backup status
task cloud:progress          # Check if sync is running
task cloud:dry-run           # Preview what would sync

# View logs
task cloud:logs              # Vzdump sync logs
task cloud:logs:photos       # Photos sync logs
```

## Restore Procedures

### Full Container Restore

```bash
# 1. List available backups
task backup:list APP=openwebui

# 2. Restore to new container ID (recommended for testing)
task backup:restore BACKUP=vzdump-lxc-501-2025_12_10-19_28_32.tar.zst TARGET_ID=505

# 3. Verify restored container
ssh root@homelab "pct start 505"

# 4. If verified, swap with original:
#    - Stop original (501)
#    - Update network config on new container
#    - Start new container
```

### Database-Only Restore

```bash
# Immich PostgreSQL
task backup:immich:db:restore DUMP=immich-postgres-20251207_020000.sql.gz

# Other databases - manual restore from /tank/backups/database-dumps/
ssh root@homelab "ls -lh /tank/backups/database-dumps/"
```

### Extract Files from Backup

```bash
ssh root@homelab
cd /tmp
tar -xf /tank/backups/vzdump/dump/vzdump-lxc-501-2025_12_10-19_28_32.tar.zst
# Navigate and extract needed files
```

## Monitoring

### Check Backup Status

```bash
# View scheduled jobs
ssh root@homelab "cat /etc/pve/jobs.cfg"

# View hook script logs
ssh root@homelab "tail -50 /var/log/vzdump-hooks.log"

# Check local storage usage
task backup:status

# Check cloud backup status
task cloud:status
```

### Proxmox UI

Backup jobs visible at: **Datacenter > Backup**

## Files Reference

| File | Location | Purpose |
|------|----------|---------|
| Job config (source) | `scripts/backup/jobs.cfg` | Scheduled vzdump job definitions |
| Hook script (source) | `scripts/backup/pre-backup-hook.sh` | Pre-backup database dumps |
| Job config (deployed) | `/etc/pve/jobs.cfg` | Synced via `task backup:sync` |
| Hook script (deployed) | `/var/lib/vz/snippets/pre-backup-hook.sh` | Synced via `task backup:sync` |

Two-layer backup system:

1. **PBS (Proxmox Backup Server)** - Incremental, deduplicated backups of all LXC containers with automatic S3 sync

## PBS Backups (Container-Level)

All LXC containers are backed up to PBS (LXC 102) with incremental deduplication. PBS then syncs to Backblaze B2 S3 backend daily.

### Daily PBS Backups

| ID | Service | Schedule | Pre-Backup Hook | Retention |
|----|---------|----------|-----------------|-----------|
| 304 | Immich | 7:00 AM | PostgreSQL dump | 7 days |
| 501 | OpenWebUI | 7:01 AM | SQLite copy | 7 days |
| 502 | n8n | Daily | SQLite copy | 7 days |
| 503 | Obsidian Sync | Daily | None | 7 days |
| 504 | Documents | Daily | PostgreSQL dump | 7 days |

### Weekly PBS Backups (Sunday 8:00 AM)

| ID | Service | Pre-Backup Hook | Retention |
|----|---------|-----------------|-----------|
| 101 | Network Services (AdGuard) | None | 4 weeks |
| 200 | Traefik | None | 4 weeks |
| 201 | Dashboards | None | 4 weeks |
| 203 | Authentik | None | 4 weeks |
| 401 | Jellyfin | Jellystat PostgreSQL dump | 4 weeks |
| 402 | Media Management | None | 4 weeks |
| 500 | Monitoring | None | 4 weeks |

### PBS S3 Sync

PBS syncs the local `homelab` datastore to the `backblaze-s3` S3-backed datastore daily.

| Sync Job | Schedule | Source | Destination |
|----------|----------|--------|-------------|
| `test-sync` | 5:00 AM | `homelab` datastore | `backblaze-s3` (S3 backend) |

### Excluded Containers

- **303 (immich-importer)** - Stateless, handles photo import only
- **104 (container-mgmt)** - Stateless, runs Pulse + Arcane agents

## User Data Sync (rclone to B2)

Large user data files are synced directly to Backblaze B2 using rclone with encryption, bypassing PBS for efficiency.

| Data Type | LXC | Schedule | Source | Destination |
|-----------|-----|----------|--------|-------------|
| Photos | 303 | Wed/Sun 3:00 AM | `/photos` | `b2-crypt:photos-encrypted` |
| Documents | 504 | Wed/Sun 3:30 AM | docker volume `paperless-media` | `b2-crypt:documents` |

### Why Two Systems?

- **PBS** is ideal for full container recovery with deduplication
- **rclone** is better for large media files that users may want to restore individually
- Photos and documents can be browsed/restored from B2 without a full PBS restore

## Taskfile Commands

### PBS Backups

```bash
# Trigger manual backup
task pbs:backup APP=n8n

# Backup all apps
task pbs:backup:all

# List snapshots for an app
task pbs:backup:list APP=n8n

# Show backup timer status
task pbs:backup:status APP=n8n

# Restore from PBS (stops containers, restores data, restarts)
task pbs:backup:restore APP=n8n
task pbs:backup:restore APP=n8n SNAPSHOT=latest
task pbs:backup:restore APP=n8n DATASTORE=backblaze-s3  # Restore from S3
```

### User Data Sync (Cloud Backups)

```bash
# Trigger cloud sync
task cloud:sync              # Both photos
task cloud:sync:photos       # Photos only

# Check status
task cloud:status            # B2 bucket sizes
task cloud:status:photos     # Photos backup status
task cloud:progress          # Check if sync is running
task cloud:dry-run           # Preview what would sync

# View logs
task cloud:logs:photos       # Photos sync logs
```

### Documents Cloud Sync

```bash
# SSH to documents LXC and run manually
ssh root@10.100.5.104 "/usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh documents"
ssh root@10.100.5.104 "/usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh status"
ssh root@10.100.5.104 "tail -f /var/log/cloud-sync-documents.log"
```

## Restore Procedures

### Full Container Recovery (via PBS)

See [disaster-recovery.md](./disaster-recovery.md) for detailed procedures.

```bash
# 1. Recreate container infrastructure
task tofu:init APP=n8n
task tofu:apply APP=n8n

# 2. Restore data from PBS
task pbs:backup:restore APP=n8n

# 3. Or restore from S3 (if local PBS lost)
task pbs:backup:restore APP=n8n DATASTORE=backblaze-s3
```

### Database-Only Restore

```bash
# Immich PostgreSQL
task backup:immich:db:restore DUMP=immich-postgres-20251207_020000.sql.gz

# Other databases - use pre-backup dumps in docker volumes
ssh root@10.100.5.104 "ls /config/*.sql.gz"  # Documents
```

## Daily Timeline

```text
05:00 AM - PBS S3 sync (homelab → backblaze-s3)
07:00 AM - PBS daily backups (user data containers)
08:00 AM - PBS weekly backups (infrastructure, Sundays only)

03:00 AM - Photos cloud sync to B2 (Wed/Sun)
03:30 AM - Documents cloud sync to B2 (Wed/Sun)
```

## Storage Locations

### PBS Datastores

| Datastore | Type | Path/Bucket | Purpose |
|-----------|------|-------------|---------|
| `homelab` | Local | `/mnt/datastore/homelab` | Primary local backups |
| `backblaze-s3` | S3 | `rambtech-homelab` bucket | Off-site cloud sync |

### Backblaze B2 Bucket Structure

```text
rambtech-homelab/
├── ct/                    # PBS S3 datastore (container backups)
│   ├── 101/               # Network Services snapshots
│   ├── 304/               # Immich snapshots
│   └── ...
├── photos-encrypted/      # rclone crypt - Immich photos
└── documents/             # rclone crypt - Paperless documents
```

## PBS Management

### Check PBS Status

```bash
# SSH to PBS
ssh root@10.100.1.102

# List datastores
proxmox-backup-manager datastore list

# List backups in a datastore
proxmox-backup-client list --repository root@pam@localhost:homelab
proxmox-backup-client list --repository root@pam@localhost:backblaze-s3

# Check sync job status
proxmox-backup-manager sync-job list

# Manual sync trigger
proxmox-backup-manager sync-job run test-sync
```

### PBS Web UI

- URL: https://pbs.homelab.rambtech.dev or https://10.100.1.102:8007
- Login: root@pam

## Database Notes

### Immich (304)

- PostgreSQL with pgvecto-rs extension (ML embeddings)
- Container: `immich_postgres`
- Pre-backup dump in PBS backup

### Paperless-ngx (504)

- PostgreSQL 16
- Container: `paperless-db`
- Pre-backup dump: `/config/paperless-db-backup.sql.gz`

### Obsidian Sync (503)

- CouchDB 3.5
- Data in docker volume `couchdb-data`
- No pre-backup dump needed (CouchDB handles consistency)

### OpenWebUI (501)

- SQLite at `/config/openwebui/webui.db`
- Contains chat history, users, settings
- Copied directly in PBS backup

### n8n (502)

- SQLite at `/config/n8n/database.sqlite`
- Contains workflows, credentials, execution history

# Homelab Backup Strategy

## Overview

Two-tier backup system with daily backups for user data services and weekly backups for infrastructure. All backups are synced to Backblaze B2 (encrypted) for off-site redundancy.

## Backup Tiers

### Daily Backups (2:00 AM)

User data that changes frequently - kept for 7 days.

| ID | Service | Pre-Backup Hook |
|----|---------|-----------------|
| 304 | Immich | PostgreSQL dump |
| 501 | OpenWebUI | SQLite copy |
| 502 | n8n | SQLite copy |

### Weekly Backups (Sunday 3:00 AM)

Infrastructure services that rarely change - kept for 4 weeks.

| ID | Service | Pre-Backup Hook |
|----|---------|-----------------|
| 101 | Network Services (AdGuard) | None |
| 200 | Traefik | None |
| 201 | Dashboards | None |
| 202 | Authelia | None |
| 401 | Jellyfin | Jellystat PostgreSQL dump |
| 402 | Media Management | None |
| 500 | Monitoring | None |

### Excluded Containers

- **303 (immich-importer)** - Stateless, runs cron jobs only
- **600 (desktop-tmp)** - Temporary GUI container

## Cloud Backup (Backblaze B2)

All local backups are synced to Backblaze B2 with rclone crypt encryption.

| Sync | Schedule | Source | Destination |
|------|----------|--------|-------------|
| Photos | Daily 3:00 AM | LXC 303 `/photos` | `b2-crypt:` |
| Vzdump | Daily 4:00 AM | `/tank/backups/vzdump` | `b2-crypt:vzdump` |
| DB Dumps | Daily 4:00 AM | `/tank/backups/database-dumps` | `b2-crypt:database-dumps` |

### Daily Timeline

```text
2:00 AM - Daily vzdump backups (immich, openwebui, n8n)
3:00 AM - Photos cloud sync to B2
4:00 AM - Vzdump + DB dumps cloud sync to B2
```

## Storage Layout

```text
/tank/backups/
├── vzdump/dump/           # Proxmox vzdump backups
│   ├── vzdump-lxc-100-*.tar.zst
│   ├── vzdump-lxc-101-*.tar.zst
│   └── ...
└── database-dumps/        # Pre-backup database dumps
    ├── immich-postgres-*.sql.gz
    ├── jellystat-postgres-*.sql.gz
    ├── openwebui-*.db
    └── n8n-*.db
```

## Taskfile Commands

### Local Backups

```bash
# Sync backup config to Proxmox
task backup:sync

# View status
task backup:status

# Manual backups
task backup:now APP=openwebui    # Single container
task backup:all                   # All containers

# List backups for an app
task backup:list APP=immich

# Restore container
task backup:restore BACKUP=vzdump-lxc-304-2025_12_07-02_00_00.tar.zst TARGET_ID=305

# Immich database operations
task backup:immich:db              # Manual dump
task backup:immich:db:restore DUMP=immich-postgres-20251207_020000.sql.gz
```

### Cloud Backups

```bash
# Trigger cloud sync
task cloud:sync              # Both vzdump + photos
task cloud:sync:vzdump       # Vzdump only
task cloud:sync:photos       # Photos only

# Check status
task cloud:status            # B2 bucket sizes
task cloud:status:photos     # Photos backup status
task cloud:progress          # Check if sync is running
task cloud:dry-run           # Preview what would sync

# View logs
task cloud:logs              # Vzdump sync logs
task cloud:logs:photos       # Photos sync logs
```

## Restore Procedures

### Full Container Restore

```bash
# 1. List available backups
task backup:list APP=openwebui

# 2. Restore to new container ID (recommended for testing)
task backup:restore BACKUP=vzdump-lxc-501-2025_12_10-19_28_32.tar.zst TARGET_ID=505

# 3. Verify restored container
ssh root@homelab "pct start 505"

# 4. If verified, swap with original:
#    - Stop original (501)
#    - Update network config on new container
#    - Start new container
```

### Database-Only Restore

```bash
# Immich PostgreSQL
task backup:immich:db:restore DUMP=immich-postgres-20251207_020000.sql.gz

# Other databases - manual restore from /tank/backups/database-dumps/
ssh root@homelab "ls -lh /tank/backups/database-dumps/"
```

### Extract Files from Backup

```bash
ssh root@homelab
cd /tmp
tar -xf /tank/backups/vzdump/dump/vzdump-lxc-501-2025_12_10-19_28_32.tar.zst
# Navigate and extract needed files
```

## Monitoring

### Check Backup Status

```bash
# View scheduled jobs
ssh root@homelab "cat /etc/pve/jobs.cfg"

# View hook script logs
ssh root@homelab "tail -50 /var/log/vzdump-hooks.log"

# Check local storage usage
task backup:status

# Check cloud backup status
task cloud:status
```

### Proxmox UI

Backup jobs visible at: **Datacenter > Backup**

## Files Reference

| File | Location | Purpose |
|------|----------|---------|
| Job config (source) | `scripts/backup/jobs.cfg` | Scheduled vzdump job definitions |
| Hook script (source) | `scripts/backup/pre-backup-hook.sh` | Pre-backup database dumps |
| Job config (deployed) | `/etc/pve/jobs.cfg` | Synced via `task backup:sync` |
| Hook script (deployed) | `/var/lib/vz/snippets/pre-backup-hook.sh` | Synced via `task backup:sync` |
| Hook log | `/var/log/vzdump-hooks.log` | Hook script output |
| Cloud sync script | `/root/cloud-sync.sh` | Vzdump to B2 sync (on Proxmox) |
| Photos sync script | `/usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh` | Photos to B2 sync (on LXC 303) |

## Adding New Containers

1. Edit `scripts/backup/jobs.cfg`:
   - Add container ID to `daily-user-data` (for user data) or `weekly-infrastructure` (for infra)
2. Edit `scripts/backup/backup-app.sh` and `scripts/backup/backup-list.sh`:
   - Add the app name to container ID mapping
3. (Optional) If container has a database, edit `scripts/backup/pre-backup-hook.sh`:
   - Add a dump function and case in `backup-start`
4. Run `task backup:sync` to deploy configs to Proxmox

## Database Notes

### Immich (304)

- PostgreSQL with pgvecto-rs extension (ML embeddings)
- Container: `immich_postgres`
- Dumps kept 7 days

### Jellystat (401)

- PostgreSQL 15 for Jellyfin statistics
- Container: `jellystat-db`
- User/DB: `jellystat`
- Dumps kept 4 weeks

### OpenWebUI (501)

- SQLite at `/config/openwebui/webui.db`
- Contains chat history, users, settings
- Copied directly (no sqlite3 in container)

### n8n (502)

- SQLite at `/config/n8n/database.sqlite`
- Contains workflows, credentials, execution history

# =============================================================================
# Documents LXC - Paperless-ngx + Stirling-PDF
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 504
# IP: 10.100.5.104
#
# Document management stack:
# - Paperless-ngx: OCR, full-text search, auto-tagging, email consumption
# - Stirling-PDF: PDF manipulation (merge, split, compress, convert, etc.)
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1Password - Paperless Secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

data "onepassword_item" "paperless" {
  vault = data.onepassword_vault.homelab.uuid
  title = "paperless"
}

locals {
  # Flatten paperless section fields into a map by label
  _paperless_section_fields = merge([
    for s in try(data.onepassword_item.paperless.section, []) : {
      for f in try(s.field, []) : f.label => f.value
    }
  ]...)

  paperless = {
    admin_user     = try(data.onepassword_item.paperless.username, "admin")
    admin_password = try(data.onepassword_item.paperless.password, "")
    db_password    = lookup(local._paperless_section_fields, "db_password", "")
    secret_key     = lookup(local._paperless_section_fields, "secret_key", "")
  }
}

# Generate the .env file from 1Password secrets + OIDC config
resource "local_sensitive_file" "documents_env" {
  filename = "${path.module}/deploy/.env"
  content  = <<-EOT
# Documents Stack Environment
# Auto-generated by OpenTofu from 1Password
# DO NOT EDIT - changes will be overwritten

# Paperless-ngx
PAPERLESS_ADMIN_USER=${local.paperless.admin_user}
PAPERLESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${local.paperless.admin_password}
PAPERLESS_DB_PASSWORD=${local.paperless.db_password}
PAPERLESS_SECRET_KEY=${local.paperless.secret_key}

# OAuth/OIDC via Authentik (django-allauth)
PAPERLESS_SOCIALACCOUNT_PROVIDERS=${jsonencode({
    openid_connect = {
      APPS = [{
        provider_id = "authentik"
        name        = "Authentik"
        client_id   = authentik_provider_oauth2.paperless.client_id
        secret      = random_password.paperless_oidc_secret.result
        settings = {
          server_url = "https://auth.${var.domain_public}/application/o/paperless/"
        }
      }]
      OAUTH_PKCE_ENABLED = "True"
    }
  })}
EOT

  file_permission = "0600"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 504
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 4  # OCR is CPU intensive
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 8192  # OCR needs memory
}

variable "swap" {
  type    = number
  default = 2048
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 64  # Documents can grow large
}

# Cloud backup schedule (default: Wed and Sun at 3:30 AM, after photos backup)
variable "cloud_backup_schedule" {
  type    = string
  default = "30 3 * * 0,3"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Documents Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "documents" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "documents"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.monitoring.documents}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Ensure .env is generated before file sync
  depends_on = [local_sensitive_file.documents_env]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = local.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Documents"
  service_description = "Document management with Paperless-ngx (OCR) and Stirling-PDF (utilities)"

  service_urls = {
    paperless_internal    = "https://docs.${var.domain_internal}"
    paperless_public      = "https://docs.${var.domain_public}"
    stirling_pdf_internal = "https://pdf.${var.domain_internal}"
    stirling_pdf_public   = "https://pdf.${var.domain_public}"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Paperless-ngx", port = 8000, info = "Document management with OCR" },
    { name = "Stirling-PDF", port = 8080, info = "PDF manipulation tools" },
    { name = "PostgreSQL", port = 5432, info = "Paperless database (internal)" },
    { name = "Redis", port = 6379, info = "Paperless cache (internal)" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f paperless
cd /config && docker compose logs -f stirling-pdf
```

**Restart services:**
```
cd /config && docker compose restart paperless
cd /config && docker compose restart stirling-pdf
```

**Import documents:**
Place files in `/config/consume/` - they'll be automatically imported.

**Export all documents:**
```
cd /config && docker compose exec paperless document_exporter ../export/
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=documents` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["documents", "paperless", "pdf", "ocr"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "documents_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.documents.container_id
  container_ip   = module.documents.ip_address
  container_name = "documents"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = local.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "daily"
    retention = "7"
    namespace = "lxc-504"

    pre_backup_commands = [{
      name    = "PostgreSQL dump (Paperless)"
      command = "docker exec paperless-db pg_dump -U paperless -d paperless --clean --if-exists | gzip > /config/paperless-db-backup.sql.gz"
      timeout = 300
    }]

    include_paths = ["/config", "/var/lib/docker/volumes"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,documents,paperless"
  }

  # Container monitoring agents
  pulse_agent = {
    enabled     = true
    pulse_token = local.agent_tokens["documents"].pulse_token
  }

  arcane_agent = {
    enabled         = true
    bootstrap_token = local.agent_tokens["documents"].arcane_bootstrap_token
  }

  alloy_agent = {
    enabled  = true
    username = local.op.alloy_telemetry_username
    password = local.op.alloy_telemetry_password
  }

  depends_on = [module.documents]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Generate rclone config from 1Password secrets
resource "local_sensitive_file" "rclone_conf" {

[b2]
type = b2
account = ${local.op.b2_account_id}
key = ${local.op.b2_application_key}
hard_delete = true

[b2-crypt]
type = crypt
remote = b2:rambtech-homelab/documents

password2 = ${local.op.rclone_crypt_password2}
CONF
}

# Install rclone via Ansible
resource "ansible_navigator_run" "install_rclone" {
  depends_on = [module.documents]

  triggers = {
    container_id = var.container_id
  }

  execution_environment = {
    enabled = false
  }

  ansible_options = {
    private_keys = [{
      name = "homelab"
      data = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    }]
  }

  playbook = <<-EOT
    - name: Install rclone for cloud backup
      hosts: lxc
      gather_facts: no

      tasks:
        - name: Check if rclone is installed
          ansible.builtin.command:
            cmd: which rclone
          register: rclone_check
          changed_when: false
          failed_when: false

        - name: Install rclone
          ansible.builtin.shell:
            cmd: curl -fsSL https://rclone.org/install.sh | bash
          when: rclone_check.rc != 0

        - name: Create rclone config directory
          ansible.builtin.file:
            path: /root/.config/rclone
            state: directory
            mode: '0700'

        - name: Ensure cron is installed
          ansible.builtin.apt:
            name: cron
            state: present
            update_cache: yes
            cache_valid_time: 3600
  EOT

  inventory = yamlencode({
    lxc = {
      hosts = {
        "documents" = {

          ansible_user = "root"
        }
      }
    }
  })
}

# Deploy rclone config
resource "filesync_file" "rclone_conf" {

  ssh_user     = "root"
  ssh_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [ansible_navigator_run.install_rclone]
}

# Deploy cloud-sync script
resource "filesync_file" "cloud_sync_script" {
  source      = "${path.module}/deploy/cloud-sync.sh"
  destination = "/usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh"
  host        = module.documents.ip_address

  mode         = "0755"
  ssh_user     = "root"
  ssh_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [ansible_navigator_run.install_rclone]
}

# Configure cron job for cloud backup
resource "ansible_navigator_run" "configure_cron" {
  depends_on = [
    filesync_file.cloud_sync_script,
    filesync_file.rclone_conf
  ]

  triggers = {
    container_id   = var.container_id
    cloud_schedule = var.cloud_backup_schedule
  }

  execution_environment = {
    enabled = false
  }

  ansible_options = {
    private_keys = [{
      name = "homelab"
      data = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    }]
  }

  playbook = <<-EOT
    - name: Configure cloud backup cron job
      hosts: lxc
      gather_facts: no
      vars:
        cloud_schedule: "${var.cloud_backup_schedule}"

      tasks:
        - name: Add cloud backup cron job (B2 sync)
          ansible.builtin.cron:
            name: "Cloud backup documents to B2"
            minute: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[0] }}"
            hour: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[1] }}"
            day: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[2] }}"
            month: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[3] }}"
            weekday: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[4] }}"
            job: "/usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh documents >> /var/log/cloud-sync-documents.log 2>&1"
            user: root

        - name: Ensure cron service is enabled and running
          ansible.builtin.systemd:
            name: cron
            enabled: yes
            state: started

        - name: Display cron configuration
          ansible.builtin.debug:
            msg: "Cloud backup configured: {{ cloud_schedule }}"
  EOT

  inventory = yamlencode({
    lxc = {
      hosts = {
        "documents" = {
          ansible_host = module.documents.ip_address
          ansible_user = "root"
        }
      }
    }
  })
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Routes - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Paperless-ngx route (internal only)
module "paperless_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "docs"
  backend_url = "http://${module.documents.ip_address}:8000"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "docs.${var.domain_internal}"
  public_domain   = "docs.${var.domain_public}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]
  public_middlewares   = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.documents]
}

# Stirling-PDF route (internal only)
module "stirling_pdf_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "pdf"
  backend_url = "http://${module.documents.ip_address}:8080"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "pdf.${var.domain_internal}"
  public_domain   = "pdf.${var.domain_public}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares - authentik provides SSO authentication
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers", "authentik"]
  public_middlewares   = ["cloudflare-https", "security-headers", "authentik"]
  public_entrypoint    = ["web"]

  depends_on = [module.documents]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.documents.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.documents.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.documents.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    direct_paperless      = "http://${module.documents.ip_address}:8000"
    paperless_internal    = module.paperless_route.internal_url
    paperless_public      = module.paperless_route.public_url

    direct_stirling_pdf   = "http://${module.documents.ip_address}:8080"
    stirling_pdf_internal = module.stirling_pdf_route.internal_url
    stirling_pdf_public   = module.stirling_pdf_route.public_url
  }
}

output "traefik_config_paths" {
  description = "Paths to Traefik configs on Traefik LXC"
  value = {
    paperless    = module.paperless_route.remote_config_path
    stirling_pdf = module.stirling_pdf_route.remote_config_path
  }
}

output "cloud_backup_schedule" {
  description = "Cloud backup cron schedule (to Backblaze B2)"
  value       = var.cloud_backup_schedule
}

resource "local_sensitive_file" "immich_env" {
  filename = "${path.module}/deploy/.env"
  content  = <<-EOT
# Immich Configuration
# Auto-generated by OpenTofu from 1Password
# DO NOT EDIT - changes will be overwritten
# https://immich.app/docs/install/environment-variables

# Paths - these match the LXC mount points from main.tf

# Version - use 'release' for latest stable
IMMICH_VERSION=release

# Database credentials
DB_PASSWORD=qjIYvd2gOMh71CBpgA
DB_USERNAME=postgres
DB_DATABASE_NAME=immich

# Timezone
TZ=America/New_York

# OpenTelemetry - push metrics to monitoring stack
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://10.100.5.100:4318
OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=immich
IMMICH_TELEMETRY_INCLUDE=all
EOT

  file_permission = "0600"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 304
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 6
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 6144
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 32
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Immich Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "immich" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "immich-docker"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (dual-NIC: container network + LAN for mobile app)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.photos.immich}${local.network.container_netmask}"
  lan_ip       = "${local.lan_ips.immich}${local.network.lan_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = 2048

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Enable AMD GPU passthrough for ML acceleration and video transcoding
  enable_gpu = true

  # Mount points for photos and cache
  # These are configured via SSH (null_resource.configure_mount_points) since
  # the API token doesn't have permission for bind mounts (requires root@pam)
  mount_points = [
    {
      slot   = 0
      path   = "/photos"
      volume = "/tank/photos"
    },
    {
      slot   = 1
      path   = "/cache"
      volume = "/tank/cache/immich"
    }
  ]

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = local.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Immich"
  service_description = "Self-hosted photo and video management with ML features"

  service_urls = {
    internal = "https://photos.${var.domain_internal}"
    public   = "https://photos.${var.domain_public}"
    direct   = "http://${local.lan_ips.immich}:2283"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Immich Web", port = 2283, info = "Photo management UI" },
    { name = "Immich Server", port = 2283, info = "API server" },
    { name = "Immich ML", port = 3003, info = "Machine learning service" },
    { name = "PostgreSQL", port = 5432, info = "Database" },
    { name = "Redis", port = 6379, info = "Cache" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Storage

**Photos:** `/photos` (mounted from `/tank/photos`)
**Cache:** `/cache` (mounted from `/tank/cache/immich`)
**Database:** Docker volumes (immich_pgdata)

## GPU Acceleration

AMD Radeon 890M passed through for ML acceleration:
- `/dev/dri/card0` - GPU device
- `/dev/dri/renderD128` - Render device

**Check GPU access:**
```bash
ls -la /dev/dri/
docker exec immich_machine_learning rocminfo
```

## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```bash
cd /config && docker compose logs -f immich_server
```

**Restart all services:**
```bash
cd /config && docker compose restart
```

**Force reprocess ML jobs:**
```bash
docker exec -it immich_server npm run cli -- jobs run all
```

## Database Backup

Backup script runs pre-backup hook for Proxmox vzdump.
Manual backup:
```bash
cd /config && docker compose exec -T postgres pg_dumpall -U postgres > backup.sql
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=immich` to update.

module "immich_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.immich.container_id
  container_ip   = module.immich.ip_address

#!/bin/bash
# Cloud backup sync to Backblaze B2 (encrypted)
# Runs on LXC 303 (immich-importer)

set -eu

ACTION="${1:-photos}"
DRY_RUN=""
if [ "${2:-}" = "--dry-run" ]; then
    DRY_RUN="--dry-run"
    echo "=== DRY RUN MODE ==="
fi

# Use encrypted remote for photos
B2_CRYPT="b2-crypt:"
PHOTOS_LOCAL="/photos"

RCLONE_FLAGS="--progress --transfers 4 --checkers 8 --fast-list"

sync_photos() {
    echo "=== Syncing photos to B2 - ENCRYPTED ==="
    echo "Source: $PHOTOS_LOCAL"
    echo "Dest:   $B2_CRYPT"
    echo ""

    rclone sync $PHOTOS_LOCAL $B2_CRYPT \
        $RCLONE_FLAGS \
        --exclude "*.tmp" \
        --exclude "thumbs/**" \
        --exclude "cache/**" \
        --exclude "encoded-video/**" \
        $DRY_RUN
}

show_status() {
    echo "=== B2 Photos Backup Status - Encrypted ==="
    echo ""
    echo "Remote contents:"
    rclone lsd $B2_CRYPT 2>/dev/null || echo "empty or not yet synced"
    echo ""
    echo "Remote size:"
    rclone size $B2_CRYPT 2>/dev/null || echo "not yet synced"
    echo ""
    echo "Local size:"
    du -sh $PHOTOS_LOCAL 2>/dev/null || echo "calculating..."
}

case "$ACTION" in
    photos)
        sync_photos
        ;;
    status)
        show_status
        ;;
    *)
        echo "Usage: $0 [photos|status] [--dry-run]"
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

echo ""
echo "Done"

## Photos Backup Migration Plan: LXC 303 → LXC 304

### Current State (LXC 303 - immich-importer)

| Component | Location | Schedule |
|-----------|----------|----------|
| rclone config | `/root/.config/rclone/rclone.conf` | - |
| cloud-sync.sh | `/usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh` | - |
| Cron job | `0 3 * * 0,3` | Wed/Sun 3:00 AM |
| Source | `/photos` (mount from `/tank/photos`) | - |
| Destination | `b2-crypt:` (photos-encrypted) | - |

### Target State (LXC 304 - immich)

LXC 304 already has:
- `/photos` mount from `/tank/photos` (same source)
- Docker installed (docker-lxc module)
- PBS backup configured via lxc-sidecars

Need to add:
- rclone installation (via Ansible)
- rclone.conf with B2 credentials
- cloud-sync.sh script
- Cron job for schedule

### Migration Steps

**Phase 1: Add to immich (LXC 304)**

1. Create `deploy/cloud-sync.sh` in immich app (copy from immich-importer)
2. Add to `main.tf`:
   - `local_sensitive_file.rclone_conf` - generate from 1Password secrets
   - `ansible_navigator_run.install_rclone` - install rclone + cron
   - `filesync_file.rclone_conf` - deploy config
   - `filesync_file.cloud_sync_script` - deploy script
   - `ansible_navigator_run.configure_cloud_cron` - setup cron job
3. Run `task tofu:apply APP=immich`

**Phase 2: Verify on LXC 304**

1. SSH to LXC 304, verify rclone works: `rclone lsd b2-crypt:`
2. Dry run: `/usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh photos --dry-run`
3. Manual sync: `/usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh photos`
4. Verify cron: `crontab -l`

**Phase 3: Remove from immich-importer (LXC 303)**

1. Remove from `main.tf`:
   - `local_sensitive_file.rclone_conf`
   - `ansible_navigator_run.install_rclone` → Keep rclone installed (icloudpd may use it)
   - `filesync_file.rclone_conf`
   - `filesync_file.cloud_sync_script`
   - Cloud backup cron job from `ansible_navigator_run.configure_cron`
2. Run `task tofu:apply APP=immich-importer`

**Phase 4: Update Taskfile**

Update `tasks/cloud.yml` to point to LXC 304 instead of 303 for photos sync.

### Why Move to LXC 304?

1. **Single point of management**: Photos storage and backup in same container
2. **Cleaner separation**: immich-importer focuses on import/iCloud sync only
3. **Consistency**: Matches documents pattern (paperless-ngx container runs its own backup)
4. **Reduced complexity**: Fewer mount dependencies between containers

### Schedule Consideration

- Current photos: `0 3 * * 0,3` (Wed/Sun 3:00 AM)
- Current documents: `30 3 * * 0,3` (Wed/Sun 3:30 AM)
- Keep 30-minute offset to avoid simultaneous B2 uploads

#!/bin/bash
# Cloud backup sync to Backblaze B2 (encrypted)
# Runs on LXC 304 (immich)
#
# Syncs photos to B2 with encryption
# Excludes thumbnails, cache, and encoded video (regenerable from originals)

set -eu

ACTION="${1:-photos}"
DRY_RUN=""
if [ "${2:-}" = "--dry-run" ]; then
    DRY_RUN="--dry-run"
    echo "=== DRY RUN MODE ==="
fi

# Use encrypted remote for photos
B2_CRYPT="b2-crypt:"
PHOTOS_LOCAL="/photos"

RCLONE_FLAGS="--progress --transfers 4 --checkers 8 --fast-list"

sync_photos() {
    echo "=== Syncing photos to B2 - ENCRYPTED ==="
    echo "Source: $PHOTOS_LOCAL"
    echo "Dest:   $B2_CRYPT"
    echo ""

    if [ ! -d "$PHOTOS_LOCAL" ]; then
        echo "ERROR: Source directory not found: $PHOTOS_LOCAL"
        echo "Make sure /photos mount is available"
        exit 1
    fi

    rclone sync "$PHOTOS_LOCAL" "$B2_CRYPT" \
        $RCLONE_FLAGS \
        --exclude "*.tmp" \
        --exclude "thumbs/**" \
        --exclude "cache/**" \
        --exclude "encoded-video/**" \
        $DRY_RUN
}

show_status() {
    echo "=== B2 Photos Backup Status - Encrypted ==="
    echo ""
    echo "Remote contents:"
    rclone lsd $B2_CRYPT 2>/dev/null || echo "empty or not yet synced"
    echo ""
    echo "Remote size:"
    rclone size $B2_CRYPT 2>/dev/null || echo "not yet synced"
    echo ""
    echo "Local size:"
    du -sh "$PHOTOS_LOCAL" 2>/dev/null || echo "directory not found"
}

case "$ACTION" in
    photos|sync)
        sync_photos
        ;;
    status)
        show_status
        ;;
    *)
        echo "Usage: $0 [photos|status] [--dry-run]"
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

echo ""
echo "Done"

resource "local_sensitive_file" "rclone_conf" {
  filename = "${path.module}/.tmp/rclone.conf"
  content  = <<-CONF
[b2]
type = b2
account = ${var.b2_account_id}
key = ${var.b2_application_key}
hard_delete = true

[b2-crypt]
type = crypt
remote = b2:rambtech-homelab/photos-encrypted
password = ${var.rclone_crypt_password}
password2 = ${var.rclone_crypt_password2}
CONF
}

resource "local_sensitive_file" "icloud_env" {
  filename = "${path.module}/.tmp/icloud-env.sh"
  content  = <<-EOF
# iCloud sync environment variables
export ICLOUD_USERNAME="${var.icloud_username}"
export ICLOUD_DOWNLOAD_DIR="${var.icloud_download_dir}"
export IMMICH_SERVER="${local.immich_server}"
export IMMICH_API_KEY="${var.immich_api_key}"
export NTFY_SERVER="${var.ntfy_server}"
export NTFY_TOPIC="${var.ntfy_topic}"
EOF
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Deploy Config Files via filesync
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "filesync_file" "rclone_conf" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.rclone_conf.filename
  destination = "/root/.config/rclone/rclone.conf"
  host        = local.ssh_host

  mode         = "0600"
  ssh_user     = "root"
  ssh_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [ansible_navigator_run.install_dependencies]
}

resource "filesync_file" "cloud_sync_script" {
  source      = "${path.module}/deploy/cloud-sync.sh"
  destination = "/usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh"
  host        = local.ssh_host

  mode         = "0755"
  ssh_user     = "root"
  ssh_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [ansible_navigator_run.install_dependencies]
}

resource "filesync_file" "icloud_sync_script" {
  source      = "${path.module}/deploy/icloud-sync.sh"
  destination = "/usr/local/bin/icloud-sync.sh"
  host        = local.ssh_host

  mode         = "0755"
  ssh_user     = "root"
  ssh_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [ansible_navigator_run.install_dependencies]
}

resource "filesync_file" "icloud_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.icloud_env.filename
  destination = "/etc/profile.d/icloud-sync.sh"
  host        = local.ssh_host

  mode         = "0644"
  ssh_user     = "root"
  ssh_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [ansible_navigator_run.install_dependencies]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Configure Cron Jobs (Cloud Backup + iCloud Sync) via Ansible
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "ansible_navigator_run" "configure_cron" {
  depends_on = [
    filesync_file.cloud_sync_script,
    filesync_file.icloud_sync_script,
    filesync_file.icloud_env,
    filesync_file.rclone_conf
  ]

  triggers = {
    container_id        = var.container_id
    cloud_schedule      = var.cloud_backup_schedule
    icloud_schedule     = var.icloud_sync_schedule
    icloud_sync_command = "sync-albums"  # Change this to trigger cron update
  }

  execution_environment = {
    enabled = false  # Run ansible directly on host
  }

  ansible_options = {
    private_keys = [{
      name = "homelab"
      data = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    }]
  }

  playbook = <<-EOT
    - name: Configure cron jobs for immich-importer
      hosts: lxc
      gather_facts: no
      vars:
        app_name: immich-importer
        cloud_schedule: "${var.cloud_backup_schedule}"
        icloud_schedule: "${var.icloud_sync_schedule}"

      tasks:
        # =====================================================================
        # Configure Cron Jobs
        # =====================================================================
        - name: Add cloud backup cron job (B2 sync)
          ansible.builtin.cron:
            name: "Cloud backup to B2"
            minute: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[0] }}"
            hour: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[1] }}"
            day: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[2] }}"
            month: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[3] }}"
            weekday: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[4] }}"
            job: "/usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh photos >> /var/log/cloud-sync-photos.log 2>&1"
            user: root

        - name: Add iCloud sync cron job
          ansible.builtin.cron:
            name: "iCloud photo sync"
            minute: "{{ icloud_schedule.split()[0] }}"
            hour: "{{ icloud_schedule.split()[1] }}"
            day: "{{ icloud_schedule.split()[2] }}"
            month: "{{ icloud_schedule.split()[3] }}"
            weekday: "{{ icloud_schedule.split()[4] }}"
            job: ". /etc/profile.d/icloud-sync.sh && /usr/local/bin/icloud-sync.sh sync-albums >> /var/log/icloud-sync.log 2>&1"
            user: root

        # =====================================================================
        # Ensure Cron Service is Running
        # =====================================================================
        - name: Ensure cron service is enabled and running
          ansible.builtin.systemd:
            name: cron
            enabled: yes
            state: started

        - name: Display cron configuration
          ansible.builtin.debug:
            msg:
              - "Cron configured for {{ app_name }}"
              - "  Cloud backup: {{ cloud_schedule }}"
              - "  iCloud sync:  {{ icloud_schedule }}"
  EOT

  inventory = yamlencode({
    lxc = {
      hosts = {
        "immich-importer" = {
          ansible_host = local.ssh_host
          ansible_user = "root"
        }
      }
    }
  })
}

    filesync_file.icloud_sync_script,
    filesync_file.icloud_env,
    filesync_file.rclone_conf
  ]

  triggers = {
    container_id        = var.container_id
    cloud_schedule      = var.cloud_backup_schedule
    icloud_schedule     = var.icloud_sync_schedule
    icloud_sync_command = "sync-albums"  # Change this to trigger cron update
  }

  execution_environment = {
    enabled = false  # Run ansible directly on host
  }

  ansible_options = {
    private_keys = [{
      name = "homelab"
      data = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    }]
  }

  playbook = <<-EOT
    - name: Configure cron jobs for immich-importer
      hosts: lxc
      gather_facts: no
      vars:
        app_name: immich-importer
        cloud_schedule: "${var.cloud_backup_schedule}"
        icloud_schedule: "${var.icloud_sync_schedule}"

      tasks:
        # =====================================================================
        # Configure Cron Jobs
        # =====================================================================
        # Cloud backup moved to immich LXC (304) - remove old cron job
        - name: Remove cloud backup cron job (moved to immich LXC)
          ansible.builtin.cron:
            name: "Cloud backup to B2"
            state: absent
            user: root

        - name: Add iCloud sync cron job
          ansible.builtin.cron:
            name: "iCloud photo sync"
            minute: "{{ icloud_schedule.split()[0] }}"
            hour: "{{ icloud_schedule.split()[1] }}"
            day: "{{ icloud_schedule.split()[2] }}"
            month: "{{ icloud_schedule.split()[3] }}"
            weekday: "{{ icloud_schedule.split()[4] }}"
            job: ". /etc/profile.d/icloud-sync.sh && /usr/local/bin/icloud-sync.sh sync-albums >> /var/log/icloud-sync.log 2>&1"
            user: root

        # =====================================================================
        # Ensure Cron Service is Running
        # =====================================================================
        - name: Ensure cron service is enabled and running
          ansible.builtin.systemd:
            name: cron
            enabled: yes
            state: started

        - name: Display cron configuration
          ansible.builtin.debug:
            msg:
              - "Cron configured for {{ app_name }}"
              - "  Cloud backup: {{ cloud_schedule }}"
              - "  iCloud sync:  {{ icloud_schedule }}"
  EOT

  inventory = yamlencode({
    lxc = {
      hosts = {
        "immich-importer" = {
          ansible_host = local.ssh_host
          ansible_user = "root"
        }
      }
    }
  })
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.lxc.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = local.ssh_host
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = "ssh root@${local.ssh_host}"
}

output "cloud_backup_schedule" {
  value = var.cloud_backup_schedule
}

output "icloud_sync_schedule" {
  value = var.icloud_sync_schedule
}

# Cloud Backup Operations (Backblaze B2)
# https://taskfile.dev
#
# Encrypted backups to Backblaze B2 via rclone crypt

version: '3'

tasks:
  cloud:sync:
    desc: "Sync all backups to Backblaze B2 (vzdump on Proxmox, photos in LXC 303)"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Starting vzdump sync on Proxmox..."
        ssh root@homelab "nohup /root/cloud-sync.sh vzdump > /var/log/cloud-sync.log 2>&1 &"
        echo "Starting photos sync in LXC 303..."
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- bash -c 'nohup bash /usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh photos > /var/log/cloud-sync-photos.log 2>&1 &'"
        echo ""
        echo "Cloud sync started (encrypted):"
        echo "  - Vzdump: Proxmox -> b2-crypt:vzdump"
        echo "  - Photos: LXC 303 -> b2-crypt:photos-encrypted"
        echo ""
        echo "Monitor with: task cloud:progress"

  cloud:sync:vzdump:
    desc: "Sync vzdump backups to Backblaze B2 (runs in background on Proxmox)"
    cmds:
      - |
        ssh root@homelab "nohup /root/cloud-sync.sh vzdump > /var/log/cloud-sync-vzdump.log 2>&1 &"
        echo "Vzdump sync started in background on Proxmox"
        echo "Monitor with: ssh root@homelab 'tail -f /var/log/cloud-sync-vzdump.log'"

  cloud:sync:photos:
    desc: "Sync photos to Backblaze B2 (runs in LXC 303 immich-importer)"
    cmds:
      - |
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- bash -c 'nohup bash /usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh photos > /var/log/cloud-sync-photos.log 2>&1 &'"
        echo "Photos sync started in background on LXC 303 (immich-importer)"
        echo "Monitor with: task cloud:logs:photos"

  cloud:status:
    desc: "Show Backblaze B2 bucket status"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "/root/cloud-sync.sh status"

  cloud:status:photos:
    desc: "Show photos backup status (local vs remote size)"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- bash /usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh status"

  cloud:dry-run:
    desc: "Preview what would be synced to B2 (no actual upload)"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "=== Vzdump dry run ==="
        ssh root@homelab "/root/cloud-sync.sh vzdump --dry-run"
        echo ""
        echo "=== Photos dry run ==="
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- bash /usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh photos --dry-run"

  cloud:logs:
    desc: "Tail cloud sync logs (all)"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "tail -f /var/log/cloud-sync.log"

  cloud:logs:photos:
    desc: "Tail photos sync logs (from LXC 303)"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- tail -f /var/log/cloud-sync-photos.log"

  cloud:progress:
    desc: "Check if cloud sync is still running"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "=== Proxmox (vzdump sync) ==="
        ssh root@homelab "pgrep -af 'cloud-sync.sh' || echo 'No vzdump sync running'"
        echo ""
        echo "=== LXC 303 (photos sync) ==="
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- pgrep -af 'cloud-sync.sh' || echo 'No photos sync running'"
        echo ""
        echo "=== Recent photos log ==="
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- tail -10 /var/log/cloud-sync-photos.log 2>/dev/null || echo 'No logs yet'"

version: '3'

tasks:

      - |
        echo "Starting photos sync in LXC 304 (immich)..."
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 304 -- bash -c 'nohup bash /usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh photos > /var/log/cloud-sync-photos.log 2>&1 &'"

        echo ""
        echo "Cloud sync started (encrypted):"
        echo "  - Photos: LXC 304 -> b2-crypt:photos-encrypted"
        echo "  - Documents: LXC 504 -> b2-crypt:documents"
        echo ""
        echo "Monitor with: task cloud:progress"

  cloud:sync:photos:
    desc: "Sync photos to Backblaze B2 (runs in LXC 304 immich)"
    cmds:
      - |
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 304 -- bash -c 'nohup bash /usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh photos > /var/log/cloud-sync-photos.log 2>&1 &'"
        echo "Photos sync started in background on LXC 304 (immich)"
        echo "Monitor with: task cloud:logs:photos"

  cloud:sync:documents:
    desc: "Sync documents to Backblaze B2 (runs in LXC 504 documents)"
    cmds:
      - |
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 504 -- bash -c 'nohup bash /usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh documents > /var/log/cloud-sync-documents.log 2>&1 &'"
        echo "Documents sync started in background on LXC 504 (documents)"
        echo "Monitor with: task cloud:logs:documents"

  cloud:status:
    desc: "Show Backblaze B2 status for photos and documents"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "=== Photos (LXC 304) ==="
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 304 -- bash /usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh status"
        echo ""
        echo "=== Documents (LXC 504) ==="
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 504 -- bash /usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh status"

  cloud:status:photos:
    desc: "Show photos backup status (local vs remote size)"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "pct exec 304 -- bash /usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh status"

  cloud:status:documents:
    desc: "Show documents backup status (local vs remote size)"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "pct exec 504 -- bash /usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh status"

  cloud:dry-run:
    desc: "Preview what would be synced to B2 (no actual upload)"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "=== Photos dry run (LXC 304) ==="
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 304 -- bash /usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh photos --dry-run"
        echo ""
        echo "=== Documents dry run (LXC 504) ==="
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 504 -- bash /usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh documents --dry-run"

  cloud:logs:photos:
    desc: "Tail photos sync logs (from LXC 304)"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "pct exec 304 -- tail -f /var/log/cloud-sync-photos.log"

  cloud:logs:documents:
    desc: "Tail documents sync logs (from LXC 504)"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "pct exec 504 -- tail -f /var/log/cloud-sync-documents.log"

  cloud:progress:
    desc: "Check if cloud sync is still running"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "=== LXC 304 (photos sync) ==="
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 304 -- pgrep -af 'cloud-sync.sh' || echo 'No photos sync running'"
        echo ""
        echo "=== LXC 504 (documents sync) ==="
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 504 -- pgrep -af 'cloud-sync.sh' || echo 'No documents sync running'"
        echo ""
        echo "=== Recent photos log ==="
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 304 -- tail -5 /var/log/cloud-sync-photos.log 2>/dev/null || echo 'No logs yet'"
        echo ""
        echo "=== Recent documents log ==="
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 504 -- tail -5 /var/log/cloud-sync-documents.log 2>/dev/null || echo 'No logs yet'"

# Cloud Backup Operations (Backblaze B2)
# https://taskfile.dev
#
# Encrypted backups to Backblaze B2 via rclone crypt

version: '3'

tasks:
  cloud:sync:
    desc: "Sync all backups to Backblaze B2 (vzdump on Proxmox, photos in LXC 303)"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Starting vzdump sync on Proxmox..."
        ssh root@homelab "nohup /root/cloud-sync.sh vzdump > /var/log/cloud-sync.log 2>&1 &"
        echo "Starting photos sync in LXC 303..."
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- bash -c 'nohup bash /usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh photos > /var/log/cloud-sync-photos.log 2>&1 &'"
        echo ""
        echo "Cloud sync started (encrypted):"
        echo "  - Vzdump: Proxmox -> b2-crypt:vzdump"
        echo "  - Photos: LXC 303 -> b2-crypt:photos-encrypted"
        echo ""
        echo "Monitor with: task cloud:progress"

  cloud:sync:vzdump:
    desc: "Sync vzdump backups to Backblaze B2 (runs in background on Proxmox)"
    cmds:
      - |
        ssh root@homelab "nohup /root/cloud-sync.sh vzdump > /var/log/cloud-sync-vzdump.log 2>&1 &"
        echo "Vzdump sync started in background on Proxmox"
        echo "Monitor with: ssh root@homelab 'tail -f /var/log/cloud-sync-vzdump.log'"

  cloud:sync:photos:
    desc: "Sync photos to Backblaze B2 (runs in LXC 303 immich-importer)"
    cmds:
      - |
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- bash -c 'nohup bash /usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh photos > /var/log/cloud-sync-photos.log 2>&1 &'"
        echo "Photos sync started in background on LXC 303 (immich-importer)"
        echo "Monitor with: task cloud:logs:photos"

  cloud:status:
    desc: "Show Backblaze B2 bucket status"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "/root/cloud-sync.sh status"

  cloud:status:photos:
    desc: "Show photos backup status (local vs remote size)"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- bash /usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh status"

  cloud:dry-run:
    desc: "Preview what would be synced to B2 (no actual upload)"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "=== Vzdump dry run ==="
        ssh root@homelab "/root/cloud-sync.sh vzdump --dry-run"
        echo ""
        echo "=== Photos dry run ==="
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- bash /usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh photos --dry-run"

  cloud:logs:
    desc: "Tail cloud sync logs (all)"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "tail -f /var/log/cloud-sync.log"

  cloud:logs:photos:
    desc: "Tail photos sync logs (from LXC 303)"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- tail -f /var/log/cloud-sync-photos.log"

  cloud:progress:
    desc: "Check if cloud sync is still running"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "=== Proxmox (vzdump sync) ==="
        ssh root@homelab "pgrep -af 'cloud-sync.sh' || echo 'No vzdump sync running'"
        echo ""
        echo "=== LXC 303 (photos sync) ==="
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- pgrep -af 'cloud-sync.sh' || echo 'No photos sync running'"
        echo ""
        echo "=== Recent photos log ==="
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- tail -10 /var/log/cloud-sync-photos.log 2>/dev/null || echo 'No logs yet'"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Cloud backup sync to Backblaze B2 (ENCRYPTED)
# Usage: ./cloud-sync.sh [vzdump|status] [--dry-run]
#
# Syncs local backups to Backblaze B2 bucket using rclone crypt.
# Run this on Proxmox host.
# Note: Photos sync is handled separately in LXC 303 (immich-importer)

set -euo pipefail

ACTION="${1:-vzdump}"
DRY_RUN=""
if [[ "${2:-}" == "--dry-run" ]]; then
    DRY_RUN="--dry-run"
    echo "=== DRY RUN MODE ==="
fi

# Use encrypted remote
B2_CRYPT="b2-crypt:"
VZDUMP_LOCAL="/tank/backups/vzdump/dump"
DB_DUMPS_LOCAL="/tank/backups/database-dumps"

# Common rclone flags for B2
RCLONE_FLAGS="--progress --transfers 4 --checkers 8 --fast-list"

sync_vzdump() {
    echo "=== Syncing vzdump backups to B2 - ENCRYPTED ==="
    echo "Source: $VZDUMP_LOCAL"
    echo "Dest:   ${B2_CRYPT}vzdump"
    echo ""

    rclone sync $VZDUMP_LOCAL ${B2_CRYPT}vzdump \
        $RCLONE_FLAGS \
        --include "*.tar.zst" \
        --include "*.log" \
        $DRY_RUN

    echo ""
    echo "=== Syncing database dumps to B2 - ENCRYPTED ==="
    echo "Source: $DB_DUMPS_LOCAL"
    echo "Dest:   ${B2_CRYPT}database-dumps"
    echo ""

    rclone sync $DB_DUMPS_LOCAL ${B2_CRYPT}database-dumps \
        $RCLONE_FLAGS \
        $DRY_RUN
}

show_status() {
    echo "=== B2 Vzdump Backup Status - Encrypted ==="
    echo ""
    echo "Vzdump remote contents:"
    rclone lsd ${B2_CRYPT}vzdump 2>/dev/null || echo "empty or not yet synced"
    echo ""
    echo "Vzdump remote size:"
    rclone size ${B2_CRYPT}vzdump 2>/dev/null || echo "not yet synced"
    echo ""
    echo "Database dumps remote size:"
    rclone size ${B2_CRYPT}database-dumps 2>/dev/null || echo "not yet synced"
    echo ""
    echo "Local vzdump size:"
    du -sh $VZDUMP_LOCAL 2>/dev/null || echo "calculating..."
    echo ""
    echo "Local database dumps size:"
    du -sh $DB_DUMPS_LOCAL 2>/dev/null || echo "calculating..."
}

case "$ACTION" in
    vzdump)
        sync_vzdump
        ;;
    status)
        show_status
        ;;
    *)
        echo "Usage: $0 [vzdump|status] [--dry-run]"
        echo ""
        echo "Note: Photos sync is handled by LXC 303 (immich-importer)"
        echo "Use: task cloud:sync:photos"
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

echo ""
echo "Done"

#!/bin/bash
# =============================================================================
# Backup Freshness Monitor
# =============================================================================
# Checks that backups are not stale and sends alerts via ntfy if issues found.
# Run via cron on Proxmox: 0 6 * * * /var/lib/vz/snippets/backup-monitor.sh
#
# Exit codes:
#   0 - All backups OK
#   1 - Alert sent (stale or missing backups)
# =============================================================================

set -euo pipefail

BACKUP_DIR="/tank/backups/vzdump/dump"
DB_DUMP_DIR="/tank/backups/database-dumps"
NTFY_URL="${NTFY_URL:-http://10.100.5.100:8093/homelab-alerts}"
LOGFILE="/var/log/backup-monitor.log"

# Thresholds in hours
DAILY_THRESHOLD=36    # Alert if daily backups > 36 hours old
WEEKLY_THRESHOLD=192  # Alert if weekly backups > 8 days old

log() {
    echo "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') $*" >> "$LOGFILE"
}

send_alert() {
    local priority="$1"
    local title="$2"
    local message="$3"
    local tags="$4"

    log "ALERT [$priority]: $title - $message"

    curl -s -o /dev/null \
        -H "Title: $title" \
        -H "Priority: $priority" \
        -H "Tags: $tags" \
        -d "$message" \
        "$NTFY_URL" || log "Failed to send ntfy alert"
}

# Check age of most recent backup file matching pattern
check_backup_age() {
    local pattern="$1"
    local name="$2"
    local threshold_hours="$3"
    local dir="${4:-$BACKUP_DIR}"

    local newest
    newest=$(find "$dir" -name "$pattern" -type f -printf '%T@ %p\n' 2>/dev/null | sort -n | tail -1 | cut -d' ' -f2-)

    if [[ -z "$newest" ]]; then
        send_alert "urgent" "Backup Missing: $name" "No backups found matching $pattern" "warning,backup"
        return 1
    fi

    local age_seconds
    age_seconds=$(( $(date +%s) - $(stat -c %Y "$newest") ))
    local age_hours=$(( age_seconds / 3600 ))

    if [[ $age_hours -gt $threshold_hours ]]; then
        local age_days=$(( age_hours / 24 ))
        send_alert "high" "Stale Backup: $name" "Last backup is ${age_days}d ${age_hours}h old (threshold: ${threshold_hours}h). File: $(basename "$newest")" "warning,backup,clock"
        return 1
    fi

    log "OK: $name - newest backup is ${age_hours}h old ($(basename "$newest"))"
    return 0
}

# =============================================================================
# Main
# =============================================================================

log "Starting backup freshness check"
ALERT_COUNT=0

# Daily backups (should be < 36 hours old)
check_backup_age "vzdump-lxc-304-*.tar.zst" "Immich (304)" $DAILY_THRESHOLD || ((ALERT_COUNT++))
check_backup_age "vzdump-lxc-501-*.tar.zst" "OpenWebUI (501)" $DAILY_THRESHOLD || ((ALERT_COUNT++))
check_backup_age "vzdump-lxc-502-*.tar.zst" "n8n (502)" $DAILY_THRESHOLD || ((ALERT_COUNT++))

# Database dumps (should be < 36 hours old)
check_backup_age "immich-postgres-*.sql.gz" "Immich DB" $DAILY_THRESHOLD "$DB_DUMP_DIR" || ((ALERT_COUNT++))
check_backup_age "openwebui-*.db" "OpenWebUI DB" $DAILY_THRESHOLD "$DB_DUMP_DIR" || ((ALERT_COUNT++))
check_backup_age "n8n-*.db" "n8n DB" $DAILY_THRESHOLD "$DB_DUMP_DIR" || ((ALERT_COUNT++))

# Weekly backups (should be < 8 days old)
check_backup_age "vzdump-lxc-100-*.tar.zst" "Portainer (100)" $WEEKLY_THRESHOLD || ((ALERT_COUNT++))
check_backup_age "vzdump-lxc-101-*.tar.zst" "Network Services (101)" $WEEKLY_THRESHOLD || ((ALERT_COUNT++))
check_backup_age "vzdump-lxc-200-*.tar.zst" "Traefik (200)" $WEEKLY_THRESHOLD || ((ALERT_COUNT++))
check_backup_age "vzdump-lxc-201-*.tar.zst" "Dashboards (201)" $WEEKLY_THRESHOLD || ((ALERT_COUNT++))
check_backup_age "vzdump-lxc-202-*.tar.zst" "Authelia (202)" $WEEKLY_THRESHOLD || ((ALERT_COUNT++))
check_backup_age "vzdump-lxc-401-*.tar.zst" "Jellyfin (401)" $WEEKLY_THRESHOLD || ((ALERT_COUNT++))
check_backup_age "vzdump-lxc-402-*.tar.zst" "Media Management (402)" $WEEKLY_THRESHOLD || ((ALERT_COUNT++))
check_backup_age "vzdump-lxc-500-*.tar.zst" "Monitoring (500)" $WEEKLY_THRESHOLD || ((ALERT_COUNT++))

log "Backup check completed: $ALERT_COUNT issues found"

if [[ $ALERT_COUNT -gt 0 ]]; then
    exit 1
fi
exit 0
